stories.title: Reconnect without resending
stories.summary: An account-scoped local intent is replayed after session verification with its original request key.
stories.boundary: An offline intent is not a completed payment. A different signed-in account cannot replay it.
stories.answer: After the owner reconnects and is authenticated, the example reuses the saved intent's request key. The accepted payment then follows normal bank confirmation; local storage alone never establishes settlement.

stories.title: Know when to abstain
stories.summary: A missing bank observation limits what an investigation can conclude.
stories.boundary: Missing evidence must stay missing. A plausible explanation is not a verified cause.
stories.answer: There is not enough evidence to identify a bank outcome or a root cause. The example can cite central acceptance and the absent observation, but it must abstain from claiming completion, failure or a particular fault.
